dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I knew it! Your strategy was outstanding in the Nilotpala Cup and Fungus Mechanicus, and it's extraordinary here, too! I suppose I should bring my A-game!

choices.text: Play another round of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: No problem! You may find yourself pleasantly surprised if you try mixing and matching different Lil' Fungi.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, Boss Golden Comet, Silver Companion! What do you think of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Stop being so formal! We're friends, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We're friends! Saying that makes it feel like we're superior and subordinate, and that creates... that, y'know... sense of distance!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: My concern is that publicly, I'm an employee of the Beast Tamers Tournament's organizer, and the two of you are our highest-level decision-makers.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: According to "500 Things You Need to Know When Organizing a Big Event", attention should always be paid to etiquette and rules, so, using the correct method of address is important as well.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I may need to take up some of your time later to meet with our sponsors and discuss the event.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Like our sponsor this time, the Fonta project team.

choices.text: I guess I can be the boss for a while...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we know nothing about business talk. They may see through our lack of experience if we're present...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "These two so-called bosses are complete amateurs! The deals we offer don't have to be that good!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And we won't be able to refute it, so it'll make everything absolutely embarrassing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that way, we'd actually be creating trouble for you, Haniyyah!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: That makes sense... Hmm, I never considered this possibility.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I see. When it comes to dealing with people, it seems I'm still lacking in experience when compared to you.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I should use this term of address carefully from now on then... No, I should give more consideration to how I deal with non-mercenaries!

choices.text: Not only that, the boss takes all the blame...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The blame? Do you mean... If they think our event didn't perform well, they might blame everything on the highest-level decision makers?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Or maybe, our title of "boss" and our reputation will put the spotlight, and thus any blame that must be laid, on us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even if we get a chance to explain ourselves, it'll definitely take a lot of time.

choices.text: We're more concerned about how you're doing, really...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Haniyyah, we haven't seen each other in a long time, and you've... changed so much! You must have gone through a lot!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Me? I think I've been living quite peacefully, in truth.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Souka taught me a lot about vocabulary and grammar after I returned from Port Ormos, and that helped me get through numerous books.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I think my level of knowledge should barely meet the standards of... the lowest level of students?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: In return, I helped Souka with physical training, and taught her more rainforest survival and combat skills.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Maybe it was her keen interest in mercenaries that kept her spirits high at all times, but I took her to meet some of my old mercenary friends, and it didn't take long for her to hit it off with them.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: What really surprised me was how we encountered some monsters on the way back...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: ...Only for Souka to leap forward and took them down with a few swings of her axe! She's got a real gift!

choices.text: Guess we look forward to you entering the Akademiya soon, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Right! Paimon's sure you'll make it, what with all the books you've been reading!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Not at all! I don't need a degree. I'm satisfied with taking care of my Fungi buddies...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Anyway, we appreciate your concern. We've been living life to the fullest lately!

choices.text: We can look forward to Souka's masterpiece soon, methinks!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, but she seemed so weak before! Paimon can't imagine how she's gotten this good at fighting!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As a writer who has personally experienced the Beast Tamers Tournament, rainforest survival, and adventure as a mercenary... A story written by Souka would certainly be special!

choices.text: Let's talk about our Fungi buddies, shall we?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Relax, Golden Comet!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Souka and I stocked up on a bunch of supplies in Port Ormos, expanded the camp, and obtained jellies with improved flavors.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bongo-Head and the others are well-fed, and even if they don't go outside their camp, they have climbing walls, swings, and seesaws to keep them from feeling bored.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: And when they go outside, the fungi get along well with the Shroomboars, Dusk Birds, and Sumpter Beasts. Sometimes, they even go for walks on the Sumpter Beasts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh, Paimon almost feels like joining them now!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: However, Ms. Najah, who is responsible for improving the Wisdom Orb, has encountered a problem and seems intent on taking the technology in a different direction.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The development of a new Orb is experiencing a huge lack of funding too, so it will be impossible to complete it at the expected rate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Yeah, we really can't be careless with it, so it can't be helped if it's slow going... If only Paimon knew how to conduct research! Then she'd at least be able to help!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Besides searching for reliable sponsors and promoting the event in advance, I came to Fontaine with the goal of finding technicians skilled in this field.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Fortunately, the Fontaine Research Institute's Fonta research team didn't just provide a huge amount of funding to us, but they also promised to help us look for the necessary talent.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's still kinda worried. Did those guys who invented Fonta really not ask anything of you?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Of course they did. They asked for naming rights and to be the sole supplier.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: As such, the next Beast Tamers Tournament might not be the Nilotpala Cup but the Fonta Cup instead. The exact name is still under discussion.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: All beverages sold by the organizer during the event must be swapped to Fonta or Fonta derivatives as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... That doesn't sound too bad?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It sounds like they're just trying to promote Fonta through the Beast Tamers Tournament...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute! If we're talking fame, then we're the ones who stand to gain from this! So it seems like we're the biggest winner, no matter how you look at it!

choices.text: There aren't any competing products right now, either!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Indeed! We've won the Fungi important funding without losing anything! It would be a waste to let this opportunity slip by!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I've carefully verified everything with Souka and Mr. Balfour too. There are no traps in the previous contract. Which is good, since I hope to do this well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, after hearing that detailed explanation from you, Haniyyah, Paimon thinks the future is looking really good!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe your trip to Fontaine will be the stepping stone to many great things.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Thanks for the kind words, Silver Companion!

choices.text: Let's make the new sponsors engage in bidding in the future!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Bidding? Do you mean making any new sponsors engage in bidding against the Fonta project team for the naming rights?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We can do that? {NICKNAME}, how are you always so full of great ideas?

choices.text: There's no such thing as free fried eggs in this world...
It's an very important device, after all.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Sure, seems you two are busy.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Don't worry, I'll be staying here for some time, so feel free to come back if you want to catch up or play another round of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta!
